visual_action: A montage of clips from a campaign rally in a large hall, possibly a gymnasium. Joe Biden and Kamala Harris walk onto a red-carpeted stage, waving to a large, cheering crowd. The crowd holds signs for the campaign. Both Harris and Biden are shown individually speaking at podiums. The venue is decorated with American flags and campaign banners.

cast.name: Joe Biden

cast.name: Kamala Harris

cast.name: Democratic Party

audio_music: An upbeat, high-energy instrumental pop track (identified as Britney Spears' 'Gimme More') plays continuously throughout the video, creating a celebratory and energetic atmosphere for the campaign rally montage. Crowd cheering is also audible.

central_claim: The Biden-Harris campaign has strong and enthusiastic support from Black voters in Philadelphia.
intended_effect: To showcase momentum and popular support for the Biden-Harris ticket, particularly among Black voters, and encourage viewers to get involved with the campaign.
